column1: # SIoT partition table (design 5.3 step 4: a *dedicated* NVS partition).
# The standard ESP32 4MB "default" table with one partition inserted: `siot`
# carved out of the front of spiffs. Everything before it keeps its stock offset
# so this table is a superset of the default rather than a rearrangement of it.
# Why a partition of its own rather than a namespace in the stock `nvs`:
#   The application firmware owns `nvs`. It is where WiFi credentials live
#   the Arduino core's own state lives
#   land by default. `nvs_flash_erase()` and a `Preferences.clear()` aimed at the
#   wrong namespace both wipe the whole of it
#   exactly that is an ordinary thing for a sketch to have. If DEVICE_SECRET were
#   in there it would go with it
column2: and the device would be an orphan (design 5.4)

column1: #   with no way back: the secret exists in the vault

#   to its own storage
column2: and survive a sketch upload by construction
